answer: The harbor index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the orchard queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1258 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the relic. A farm of 64 pays that 221 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
